name: OmaRaptor Player
author: KarPage
description: A free, super-light floating player for almost any video link, with no login and a working HUD inspired by the F-22 Raptor. mpv + yt-dlp, no browser.

barWidget.description: Left-click plays the copied video link in a floating HUD player. Right-click opens an empty player that asks for a link. Middle-click closes every player.
